author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: Infopost catalog URLs can carry a backend-controlled fragment.
findings.consequence: A catalog infopost URL such as `/dramawebben/pj%C3%A4ser?om-boken&authorid=A&titlepath=T#other` passes this validator because `URL.searchParams` ignores the fragment. The rendered link later appends `#dw`, so the browser uses the first fragment rather than the stable Dramawebben anchor, weakening the no-scroll/focus behavior around source-info opening.
findings.evidence: The validator checks origin, pathname, and exact query keys on lines 127-133 but never requires `parsed.hash === ""`; the comparable author-works infopost validator rejects fragments before accepting the same domain concept.
findings.recommendation: Require an empty fragment in `safeCatalogInfoPostUrl`, for example add `&& parsed.hash === ""` alongside the pathname/query checks, or strip fragments before constructing the display href.
verification: Cross-checked `app/lib/author-works.ts` lines 148-155, which rejects infopost URLs with fragments.
Inspected Dramawebben SSR/e2e tests covering infopost query ownership, source-info routing, URL safety, and `#dw` behavior.
Inspected owned source `app/pages/dramawebben/pjäser.vue` lines 1-543 and relevant template consumers.
